title: A pattern is a memory, check the real state before acting
description: A pattern says what was true when it was written. Look at the system before relying on it.
root_cause: Names, paths and versions change. An old pattern applied blindly can do damage.
diagnosis_steps:
1. Read the pattern.
2. Check the current state (service status, file content, version).
3. Only then apply the fix.
quick_fix: Read the pattern, then check the current state (service status, file content, version) before applying it.
root_fix: When reality and a pattern disagree, trust reality, then enrich the pattern (append) or propose it to the owner as obsolete.
